page.layout: One column of verse, set in indented lines, below the running head. Page number top right.; One block of italic verse, indented lines, in the centre and right of the page; below it a signature mark at the right.

main_text.l: Nam quisque mensis, nam lapillo est

p.i: Defessa longis utriusque Cruda rapit properante fato. Vix vix Calendis finierat dies Sacrata Ioui, nuntius attulit Heroa Cleruanum fidelem Lethifero periisse morbo: Cuius modestis pectoribus fides Antiqua sedit, rebus & asperis Spectata semper, clariorque Ambiguis nituit periclis.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "flecti" (ct ligature), "Quæ" in line 6 (initial letter partly underlined in the scan), "Quæque" in line 8. Ligatures æ and ct are rendered as printed. The first line is a fragment of the poem's opening line, cut off at the left; the poem continues from the previous page. Printed "vtriusque" and "vix" are normalised as u/v rules require.
